claim_boundary: Research supports time-varying price discovery across fragmented Bitcoin venues and identifies transaction activity as relevant to market leadership. It does not establish that Coinbase BTC-USD base-volume share is institutional demand, predicts BTC returns, or survives venue, quote-currency, outage and fee-regime changes. The prior authorizes one source-integrity and independent predictive audit only.

primary_prior_matrix.identity: Price Discovery in Cryptocurrency Markets, AEA Papers and Proceedings 109, 2019, DOI 10.1257/pandp.20191020
primary_prior_matrix.finding: The study documents material variation in which exchanges contribute to Bitcoin price discovery and finds that contribution changes when markets become segmented.
primary_prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: It does not define Coinbase-to-Binance daily base-volume share, a 28-day average, a 365-day median state or a long-cash policy.

primary_prior_matrix.identity: Price discovery in bitcoin spot and futures markets, Journal of International Money and Finance 159, 2025, DOI 10.1016/j.jimonfin.2025.103415
primary_prior_matrix.finding: The study analyzes fragmented Bitcoin markets and reports that transaction size is relevant to price leadership under asynchronous trading.
primary_prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: Trade size and high-frequency leadership are not the same as total daily base volume or directional return predictability; this is a reason to require predictive gates, not evidence of alpha.

primary_prior_matrix.identity: Coinbase Exchange API Get Product Candles documentation
primary_prior_matrix.finding: The public Exchange endpoint exposes daily BTC-USD candles including base volume, limits a response to 300 candles and warns that historical rates may be incomplete.
primary_prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: Public access does not prove continuous pre-2025 days, stable candle semantics, point-in-time availability or deterministic pagination.

primary_prior_matrix.finding: Binance documents free monthly spot kline archives and per-file checksum sidecars.
primary_prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: Archive capability does not make Coinbase and Binance volume economically comparable or establish predictive value.

economic_hypothesis: If an elevated lagged Coinbase share of comparable BTC base volume reflects a more informative or durable U.S. spot-participation regime, the fixed long-cash policy may improve after-cost matched-capital Calmar versus BTC buy-and-hold with broad Design and Validation support.

independence_assessment.distinct_from_single_venue_volume_indica: The feature is a cross-venue share of the same BTC base-volume unit and contains no price direction, MFI, Chaikin flow, taker-buy field or intraday concentration.
independence_assessment.distinct_from_stablecoin_peg_dislocation: It measures where BTC trades rather than the price of one stablecoin against another; quote-currency effects remain an adversarial confound rather than the feature.
independence_assessment.distinct_from_momentum_and_volatility: The decision feature contains no BTC return, trend, range or realized-volatility input.
independence_assessment.residual_risk: Coinbase volume share can change because of exchange outages, fee schedules, reporting semantics, U.S. access rules or Binance market structure rather than informed demand. Any common-day or semantic failure closes the exact family.

stop_conditions: Before opening any candle response, freeze exact Coinbase request partitions, Binance checksum bindings, UTC-day alignment, duplicate handling, base-volume semantics and create-only outputs.

Stop DATA_REJECT on any missing common complete day, nonpositive volume, duplicate timestamp, pagination ambiguity, response truncation, schema drift or unit mismatch; do not repair or substitute a venue or pair.

Do not change 28 days, 365 days, strict-above-median state, next-day timing, source pair, volume-share formula or mapping after any value is opened.
Close before OOS if source, prediction, matched-capital return, drawdown, Calmar, annual breadth, concentration or opportunity-cost gates fail.
